articles.summary: We’re taking a look at ProtRL: a framework for aligning protein language models to your desired distributions using reinforcement learning. Filippo Stocco is telling us all about how it works, why reinforcement learning is important for protein engineering, and how these proteins perform when tested in our lab at Adaptyv.
articles.title: Designer Spotlight: ProtRL - Reinforcement learning and the Move 37 of protein engineering
